Why taking ownership is the first step with debt.

Kevin Trudeau argues that spending habits are the one part of money you control. Instead of pointing outward, he says to look at the choices made with money you don't have.

It is a blunt message, and the good news is that choices can change. His closing advice is two words: be smart.

When did you last take full responsibility for a hard situation?
